direction.situation: On a rainy Colombo roadside, Anudi and Kasun part after their interrupted conversation. Kasun has already turned back toward his food three-wheeler.
direction.people: Anudi walks away in the left depth, wearing a cream blouse and muted teal skirt, subdued after the call. Kasun walks away on the right in a faded blue shirt and dark trousers, his head slightly lowered and his hands empty.

flow.text: Anudi continues steadily into the left depth, her phone lowered in her right hand, umbrella in her left and handbag on her left forearm. Kasun takes measured steps toward the three-wheeler in the right depth, without reaching for anything.
Neither turns back. They remain separated at the edges of the frame as the wet roadside stretches between them.

direction.camera: A wide roadside eye-level shot on a 32mm lens makes one slow dolly backward.
direction.sound: Continuous rain, distant road wash and soft receding footsteps on wet ground; no music.
